domain: Traditional qanat/falaj hydrology and water-rights adjudication — the ancient non-Western engineering-and-commons-governance craft of gravity-fed underground water delivery from a mother-well to fields, time-share apportionment by a mirab (water-master), staged channel commissioning, and graceful degradation in drought.
axioms: Water is a scarce and perishable resource: where and when it is drawn (at the tap on demand versus released upstream on a cycle) determines its freshness and who can share it.
A qanat is commissioned in stages, and each stage must independently hold water — a half-dug gallery irrigates nothing regardless of how sound the final plan is.
When the source runs low, a shared apportioned channel serves many plots from one draw, whereas every plot digging its own well wastes the source and cannot be scheduled.
Freshness decays along the channel: water (evidence) drawn upstream and early may arrive stale relative to what the field (review) actually needs now.
A well-designed system degrades gracefully — it trickles in drought rather than failing all at once; a hard single-point dependency is a channel that fails all-at-once.
The deepest failure is silting: a slow invisible accumulation no single day reveals; robust designs are self-scouring rather than requiring constant desilting.
Apportionment is adjudicated, not assumed — contention among consumers is a scheduling problem the mirab must solve before the dry season, not after.
primitives: freshness / staleness decay relative to consumption time
the shared channel versus the per-plot private well (reuse versus duplication)
the commissioning stage (a unit of infrastructure that must independently hold water)
apportionment / time-share schedule among multiple consumers
graceful degradation (trickle) versus all-at-once failure (dry channel / 404)
silting (slow invisible drift) versus self-scouring flow
failure_mode: Systematically blind to whether the water is CLEAN — it judges timing, freshness, apportionment, and staged delivery, not the authenticity or confidence-tier integrity of the evidence itself, so contaminated-but-timely water passes.
Over-indexes on the multi-consumer and drought cases and can over-engineer shared-channel apportionment for a single-agent load that never actually contends.
Frames every problem as a delivery-topology or scheduling problem and may miss defects that are about the meaning or correctness of the payload rather than its flow.
Assumes staged commissioning is always virtuous and can undervalue a monolithic delivery that is simpler when independent-shippability is not actually needed.
